# Brancy

> Brancy is a web platform for businesses that manage Instagram-centered content, messaging, marketing, analytics, shops, and customer workflows.

## Public resources

- [Brancy homepage](https://www.brancy.app/): Main public landing page.
- [Instagram management software](https://www.brancy.app/en/resources/management): Managing Instagram content, conversations, and customer workflows.
- [Instagram automation](https://www.brancy.app/en/resources/automation): Repeatable reply and message workflows with human review.
- [Instagram analytics](https://www.brancy.app/en/resources/analytics): Audience and content performance workflows.
- [Instagram marketing](https://www.brancy.app/en/resources/marketing): Connected marketing, content, communication, and commerce workflows.
- [AI Instagram assistant](https://www.brancy.app/en/resources/ai): AI-supported content and communication workflows.
- [Brancy FAQ](https://www.brancy.app/Accessibility/FAQ): Public questions and answers.
- [About Brancy](https://www.brancy.app/Accessibility/About-Us): Public company information.
- [Contact Brancy](https://www.brancy.app/Accessibility/Contact-Us): Public contact information.

## Supported language routes

- https://www.brancy.app/en
- https://www.brancy.app/fa
- https://www.brancy.app/ar

## Usage note

Use public pages as the source of truth. Do not infer private dashboard data, customer data, pricing, quotas, or backend capabilities from this file.
